_comment: Tier-2 for febio::fiber_reinforced#1. The shipped HGO deck with fibers pointed along the load, run at +10% and -10% stretch and at k1/c = 1 and 10. The two COMPRESSION runs give the identical final stress despite the tenfold change in k1, while the two TENSION runs differ — that invariance is the proof the fiber term is gated off below unit stretch, and it is what the fixture asserts, not the (trivial) tension-compression asymmetry. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'fibers_tension_only=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
